Running `import kombu.asynchronous` with `kombu==5.7.0` fails on Linux without OS tz data

Hi Kombu team! 

Upgrading to `kombu==5.7.0` broke our celery webapp running in a Linux container without an IANA database, so we needed to add `tzdata` to the requirements and redeploy. This is the same issue as #2106, but now on Linux instead of Windows. It looks like this occurred due to #2808 scoping `tzdata` to win32 only. 

To reproduce, you can run the following: (`PYTHONTZPATH` pointed at an empty dir simulates a host without OS tz data)

```bash
uv venv -p 3.13 .venv
uv pip install -p .venv kombu==5.7.0
mkdir empty
PYTHONTZPATH=$PWD/empty .venv/bin/python -I -c "import kombu.asynchronous"
```

```
  File ".../lib/python3.13/zoneinfo/_common.py", line 29, in load_tzdata
    raise ZoneInfoNotFoundError(f"No time zone found with key {key}")
zoneinfo._common.ZoneInfoNotFoundError: 'No time zone found with key UTC'
```

`kombu==5.6.2` imports fine with the same steps, because `tzdata` gets installed.

To fix this, what if we tried option 1 from #2802 and removed the need for a timezone database altogether? So in [timer.py](https://github.com/celery/kombu/blob/main/kombu/asynchronous/timer.py) it would look like 
```python
from datetime import datetime, timezone

EPOCH = datetime.fromtimestamp(0, timezone.utc)

def to_timestamp(d, default_timezone=timezone.utc, time=monotonic):
```

**Versions:** kombu 5.7.0 (5.6.2 OK), celery 5.7.0, CPython 3.13, Linux. Also reproduced on macOS via `PYTHONTZPATH`.
